title: Nursing (Top-Up)
subject: Nursing & Health
summary: For registered nurses with a diploma who want to complete a full BSc (Hons) degree.
description: This top-up lets qualified nurses build on their existing training to gain a degree, often studied part-time alongside work.
It supports career progression into senior and specialist roles.
duration: 1 year full-time or up to 2 years part-time
entryRequirements: Current registration with the Nursing and Midwifery Council (NMC)
A diploma in nursing or equivalent Level 5 qualification
